Professional Summary 
Market Data Operations professional with 6 years of experience across financial operations and market data 
administration, including 4+ years specializing in entitlement management, DACS administration, exchange reporting, 
and vendor governance within global banking environments. Proven track record managing end-to-end user lifecycle 
(provisioning through de-provisioning), invoice reconciliation, license harvesting, and audit-ready compliance 
documentation for 10,000+ users across Bloomberg, Refinitiv, and exchange platforms including NASDAQ, NYSE, OPRA, 
CBOE, ICE, HKEX, and LSE. Strong record of SLA-driven delivery, vendor cost optimization, and cross-functional 
stakeholder management.
